question: How much is the annual tuition for the Data Science program?
expected_answer: $26,000 per year.
context: Data Science (BSc, 4 years). A blend of computer science, statistics, and machine learning. You'll study programming, data structures, probability, statistical modeling, and large-scale data processing, with a strong practical lab component. Careers: data scientist, ML engineer, data analyst. Annual tuition: $26,000.

question: How long is the Architecture program and what does it cost per year?
expected_answer: The Architecture program is 5 years long. Annual tuition is $22,000 per year.
context: Architecture (BSc, 5 years). A long-form, studio-driven program covering design, structures, history, and professional practice. Careers: architect (after professional registration), architectural designer. Annual tuition: $22,000.

question: If I pay my tuition monthly, is there any extra charge, and do the other payment plans have one?
expected_answer: Yes. Plan C (ten monthly installments) adds a 2% administrative surcharge to tuition. Plan A (annual) and Plan B (semester) have no surcharge.
context: Plan A - Annual. Pay the full year's tuition by the deposit deadline (June 15, 2027 for the 2027-2028 cycle). No surcharge.
Plan B - Semester. Two equal installments, one for the Fall term and one for the Spring term. No surcharge.
Plan C - Monthly. Ten monthly installments across the academic year. A 2% administrative surcharge is added to tuition for the convenience of monthly billing.

question: Does a scholarship discount also reduce the student services fee, and how much is that fee?
expected_answer: No. Scholarship discounts apply to tuition only and never to fees, so the $450 student services fee is paid in full.
context: Discounts from scholarships apply to tuition only, never to fees.
Student services fee $450 / year, paid by all enrolled students.

question: Who qualifies for the Northwood Merit Scholarship and what does it give?
expected_answer: Any admitted student with a GPA of 3.7 or higher. It is a 50% tuition discount, awarded automatically from the admission GPA with no separate form.
context: Northwood Merit Scholarship. Who qualifies: any admitted student with a GPA of 3.7 or higher. Award: 50% tuition discount. How to apply: automatic - all applicants are considered based on their admission GPA. No separate form.

question: What do I need to qualify for the Dean's Excellence Award, what does it give, and how do I apply?
expected_answer: A GPA of 3.9 or higher AND an entrance exam score of 90 or more out of 100. The award is a flat $8,000 per year, awarded automatically from your admission GPA and entrance exam results.
context: Dean's Excellence Award. Who qualifies: students with a GPA of 3.9 or higher AND an entrance exam score of 90 or more (out of 100). Award: $8,000 per year (a flat amount, not a percentage). How to apply: automatic, based on admission GPA and entrance exam results.

question: Can I hold two scholarships at the same time?
expected_answer: No. You may hold at most one scholarship at a time. If you qualify for more than one, NIT awards the one that gives you the largest net benefit for your program.
context: One scholarship per student. You may hold at most one scholarship at a time. If you qualify for more than one, NIT awards the one that gives you the largest net benefit for your program.

question: I've been admitted to Software Engineering with a 3.8 GPA. What will I pay in tuition?
expected_answer: $12,250 per year. Software Engineering tuition is $24,500, and a 3.8 GPA qualifies for the Northwood Merit Scholarship, which is a 50% tuition discount.
context: Software Engineering (BSc, 4 years). Learn to design, build, and ship software systems. Annual tuition: $24,500.
Northwood Merit Scholarship. Who qualifies: any admitted student with a GPA of 3.7 or higher. Award: 50% tuition discount.
A Software Engineering student (tuition $24,500, see the Programs section) with the Merit Scholarship (50%) pays $12,250 in tuition.

question: What is the total first-year cost for a Mechanical Engineering student before any scholarship, and what else do I pay up front?
expected_answer: $23,750 - $23,000 tuition plus the $450 student services fee and the $300 lab fee. There is also a one-time $60 application fee, and the $1,000 deposit is credited toward tuition.
context: Mechanical Engineering (BSc, 4 years). Statics, mechanics, thermodynamics, materials, and design. Annual tuition: $23,000.

A Mechanical Engineering student (tuition $23,000) in the Engineering faculty pays, in year one: Tuition $23,000; Student services fee $450; Lab fee (Engineering) $300; Total before any scholarship: $23,750 (plus the one-time $60 application fee already paid, with the $1,000 deposit credited against tuition).

question: I'm a female applicant to Data Science with a 3.6 GPA. Which scholarship do I get, what will my tuition be, and would a higher GPA change that?
expected_answer: The Women in STEM Scholarship, a flat $5,000 per year, so tuition is $21,000 ($26,000 minus $5,000). A GPA of 3.7 or higher would instead qualify for the Merit Scholarship, which would be worth more.
context: Women in STEM Scholarship. Who qualifies: female students enrolled in a Computer Science, Engineering, or Natural Sciences program, with a GPA of 3.5 or higher. Award: $5,000 per year (a flat amount).

A Data Science student (tuition $26,000) who is female and has a 3.6 GPA qualifies for the Women in STEM Scholarship ($5,000/year), paying $21,000 in tuition. If her GPA were 3.7+, the Merit Scholarship (50%, so $13,000) would give a larger benefit, so NIT would award that instead.

question: What are the minimum GPA and entrance exam score needed to apply?
expected_answer: A high-school GPA of at least 3.0 on a 4.0 scale and an entrance exam score of at least 60 out of 100. Competitive programs may set higher cutoffs.
context: Entrance exam. All applicants sit the NIT entrance exam, scored from 0 to 100. A minimum score of 60 is required to be considered. Competitive programs may apply higher cutoffs.
GPA. We use high-school GPA on a 4.0 scale. The minimum to apply is 3.0.

question: My previous education was in Spanish. Do I need an English test?
expected_answer: Yes. Applicants whose prior education was not in English must show IELTS 6.5 or higher, or TOEFL iBT 90 or higher.
context: English (international applicants). Applicants whose prior education was not in English must show IELTS 6.5 or higher or TOEFL iBT 90 or higher.

question: When does the application window for the 2027-2028 year open and close?
expected_answer: March 15, 2027. The application window opens October 1, 2026.
context: Submit the online application and pay the non-refundable $60 application fee. The application window for the 2027-2028 year opens October 1, 2026 and closes March 15, 2027.
Admission cycle: Application opens October 1, 2026. Application deadline (closes) March 15, 2027.

question: How much is the tuition deposit, when is it due, and what happens to it?
expected_answer: By June 15, 2027. The deposit is $1,000 and is credited toward your first-year tuition.
context: Accept your offer by paying the $1,000 tuition deposit (credited toward your first-year tuition) by June 15, 2027, and choose a payment plan.
Tuition deposit deadline (accept your offer) June 15, 2027.

question: How much does a studio at Riverside Residence cost per year?
expected_answer: $8,200 per year.
context: Room options and costs. Option / Annual cost (USD): Standard double room (shared) 4,800; Single room 6,500; Studio (private, with kitchenette) 8,200.

question: When can I apply for on-campus housing?
expected_answer: Only after you have been admitted, accepted your offer and paid the $1,000 tuition deposit. Then you apply through the online housing portal and pay a $500 refundable housing deposit.
context: Get admitted and accept your offer first. Housing applications open only after you've paid your $1,000 tuition deposit.
Apply through the online housing portal and pay the $500 housing deposit. The deposit is refundable and is credited toward your first housing payment.

question: What are the Main Library opening hours?
expected_answer: Monday to Friday 08:00-22:00, and Saturday to Sunday 10:00-18:00.
context: Main Library. Spread across floors 1-3 of the Library building, with study spaces, group rooms, and an extensive digital collection. Hours: Mon-Fri 08:00-22:00; Sat-Sun 10:00-18:00.

question: Is the cafeteria open on Sunday?
expected_answer: No, the cafeteria is closed on Sunday. It is open Monday to Friday 07:30-20:00 and Saturday 09:00-16:00.
context: Cafeteria. On floor 1 of the Student Center, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Hours: Mon-Fri 07:30-20:00; Sat 09:00-16:00; closed Sunday.

question: When does the Fall term start and end, and when does the Spring term run?
expected_answer: The Fall term runs from September 7, 2027 to December 18, 2027. The Spring term runs from February 1, 2028 to May 26, 2028.
context: Academic year. Event / Date: Fall term starts September 7, 2027; Fall term ends December 18, 2027; Spring term starts February 1, 2028; Spring term ends May 26, 2028.

question: How much is the lab fee and which students pay it?
expected_answer: $300 per year, paid by students in the Computer Science, Engineering and Natural Sciences faculties.
context: Fees. Fee / Amount / Who pays: Lab fee, $300 / year, students in Computer Science, Engineering, and Natural Sciences.

question: For Civil Engineering, what degree is awarded, how many years is it, and what is the annual tuition?
expected_answer: A BSc, 4 years, at $22,500 per year.
context: Tuition summary. Program / Faculty / Degree / Years / Annual tuition: Civil Engineering, Engineering, BSc, 4, $22,500.

question: Does NIT have a medical faculty?
expected_answer: No. NIT is organized into six faculties - Computer Science, Economics & Business, Engineering, Law, Arts & Design, and Natural Sciences - and medicine is not among them.
